g.text: INSIDE THE STATIC GATE · how each step decides
Takes each test file that was
Looks for: file deleted or renamed,
test or assertion removed or rewritten,
skip / only / todo / bare return added
new tests and new test files
Allowance: TEST_LOCK_ALLOW, when the plan names
the test file as changing. It goes on the Rulings line.
You declare the pairs: schema and migrations,
API and generated client, native deps and SDK.
For each changed path, finds its
No command: printed as skipped, never a pass.
`false`: off for that workspace. The gate guesses nothing.
A test that still passed: FAIL
it does not test the change
No test runner found: n/a, set TEST_CMD.
A runner that cannot start fails the gate.
Looks for: new file in a shared layer,
not a finding when the Reuse block
Dependencies are vetted by the hook, before an
install during a run. It refuses on BLOCK.
Credentials: the CI of your project.
Silenced checkers, `as any`, "for now" comments, complex functions: your ESLint config, so the lint step fails on them.
A step that could not run (bad config, bad pattern) fails the gate. It is never a pass.
